notes: The italic *may be* was read as part of the participle's modal recasting rather than as `added` (rule 7); the head sits on *hastily*, which carries the lexeme of haste, with *gotten* as the verb the recasting supplies. Heading on *gotten* is the competing reading.
The assimilated article takes the written *the*, which stands before its own word *beginning* (rules 12, 29).
Variant WLC.PRO.20.21.v004 was resolved to r00-base, covering s002; no fallback exclusion applies (rule 53).
